name: Copper/Gold Ratio Regime — SPY Forward Returns by Quartile
description: Analyzes SPY 3-month forward returns conditioned on the copper/gold ratio 60-day ROC quartile. ROC is ranked over a 252-day rolling window: Q1 (0-25th pctile, most falling / risk-off), Q2 (25-50th), Q3 (50-75th), Q4 (75-100th, most rising / risk-on). Outputs: quartile stats table (avg return, hit rate, count, std dev), avg return bar chart by quartile, ROC line chart with regime shading, and regime change event markers.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO REGIME STUDY — SPY FORWARD RETURNS BY QUARTILE
# =============================================================================
# Signal: Copper/Gold ratio 60-day ROC, ranked into quartiles (252d rolling)
#   Q1 (0-25th pctile): Most falling ratio — strongest risk-off
#   Q2 (25-50th pctile): Mildly falling ratio
#   Q3 (50-75th pctile): Mildly rising ratio
#   Q4 (75-100th pctile): Most rising ratio — strongest risk-on
# Output: SPY 3-month forward returns by quartile
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Reference futures: HG (copper) and GC (gold)
# NoAdjustment preserves true price levels for cross-commodity ratio
hg_ref = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_ref.o, hg_ref.h, hg_ref.l, hg_ref.c, hg_ref.v, hg_ref.oi, hg_ref.s)

gc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_ref.o, gc_ref.h, gc_ref.l, gc_ref.c, gc_ref.v, gc_ref.oi, gc_ref.s)

# ffill to fill weekend/holiday NULLs in reference data
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio & 60-Day ROC ---
cg_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
ratio_roc = roc(period=60)(cg_ratio)

# --- Quartile Classification (252-day rolling percentile rank) ---
roc_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(ratio_roc)

is_q1 = roc_pctrank <= 25                           # Q1: 0-25th pctile (most falling)
is_q2 = (roc_pctrank > 25) and (roc_pctrank <= 50)  # Q2: 25-50th pctile
is_q3 = (roc_pctrank > 50) and (roc_pctrank <= 75)  # Q3: 50-75th pctile
is_q4 = roc_pctrank > 75                            # Q4: 75-100th pctile (most rising)

# --- SPY 3-Month Forward Returns (63 trading days ≈ 3 months) ---
fwd_3m = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Filter forward returns by quartile
q1_ret = where(is_q1, fwd_3m)
q2_ret = where(is_q2, fwd_3m)
q3_ret = where(is_q3, fwd_3m)
q4_ret = where(is_q4, fwd_3m)

# Hit rate: fraction of observations with positive forward return per quartile
q1_hit = where(is_q1, 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
q2_hit = where(is_q2, 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
q3_hit = where(is_q3, 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)
q4_hit = where(is_q4, 1.0 if fwd_3m > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Regime Change Detection (for event markers) ---
# Keep binary rising/falling crossover for event markers
is_rising = ratio_roc > 0
regime_to_rising = crossover(ratio_roc, 0)
regime_to_falling = crossunder(ratio_roc, 0)
regime_change = regime_to_rising or regime_to_falling

direction_val = where(regime_change, 1.0 if regime_to_rising else -1.0)
roc_at_change = where(regime_change, ratio_roc)
fwd_ret_at_change = where(regime_change, fwd_3m)

# --- Regime bands for chart shading (binary rising/falling) ---
rising_band = 1.0 if is_rising else 0.0
falling_band = 1.0 if (ratio_roc <= 0) else 0.0

ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Quartile Statistics
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY 3-Month Forward Returns by Copper/Gold Ratio ROC Quartile',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Q1 (Most Falling)', 'Q2 (Mildly Falling)', 'Q3 (Mildly Rising)', 'Q4 (Most Rising)'],
        col_headers=['Avg 3M Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Count', 'Std Dev'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio Regime',
    order=0
)(q1_ret, q1_hit, q1_ret, q1_ret, q2_ret, q2_hit, q2_ret, q2_ret, q3_ret, q3_hit, q3_ret, q3_ret, q4_ret, q4_hit, q4_ret, q4_ret)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Bar Chart — Avg 3M Return by Quartile
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Avg SPY 3-Month Return by Copper/Gold Ratio ROC Quartile',
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg 3-Month Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Most Falling)', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2 (Mildly Falling)', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Mildly Rising)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4 (Most Rising)', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    order=1
)(q1_ret, q2_ret, q3_ret, q4_ret)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Line Chart — Ratio ROC with Regime Shading
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio 60-Day ROC with Regime Shading',
    category='Copper/Gold Ratio Regime',
    y_axis_label='60d ROC',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ratio 60d ROC', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rising Regime', color=Color.Emerald, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Falling Regime', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio_roc, rising_band, falling_band))

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Regime Changes
# =============================================================================
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title='Ratio Regime Change',
    icon=Icon.ArrowLeftRightIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, card_color_map={Color.Success: [1.0], Color.Error: [-1.0]}),
        ColumnSpec(title='ROC at Crossover', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
        ColumnSpec(title='SPY 3M Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
        ColumnSpec(title='Filter', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(direction_val, roc_at_change, fwd_ret_at_change, regime_change)
